title: Chassis & Structural Frame Roadworthiness Rule
citation: UAE Unified Motor Vehicle Insurance Policy (CBUAE Standard applied by Sukoon, Orient, ADNIC), Chapter 1, Section 2, Article 7(3)
text: Where accidental collision impact causes direct structural distortion, bending, or damage to the vehicle chassis, unibody floorpan, quarter-panel structural assembly, or central pillar frame such that repair cannot restore certified roadworthiness without compromising passenger compartment integrity, the vehicle shall be classified as an outright Total Loss regardless of the economic repair percentage.
